newsitem.title: FRANCE: Strike hits Air France cargo centre.
newsitem.headline: Strike hits Air France cargo centre.

text.p: Air France freight handling facilities at Paris' Charles de Gaulle (CDG) airport have been brought to a standstill by striking personnel, an Air France Cargo official told Reuters.

"Since yesterday (Thursday) evening, when the strike began, freight handling services and reservations have been suspended indefinitely. Negotiations are taking place with the management to resolve the stoppage" the official said.
A vast majority of Air France cargo handling staff at CDG were supporting the strike which had been called to protest a new pay structure, he added.
Meanwhile, Air France pilots will decide this afternoon whether to stage a four-day strike between March 23 and 26 in protest over the planned recruitment of 450 younger pilots on lower pay.

Air France chairman, Christian Blanc, said the four-day strike was "indefensible (and) will have a cataclysmic economic and commerical effect on the company and will cost more than one billion francs ($175.3 million). - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+5017 ($ = 5.704 French Francs)
